title: TaskEnvelope
description: Wrapper for a task dispatched to an agent within a workflow run

taskId.description: Unique identifier for this task instance

workflowId.description: Identifier of the workflow this task belongs to

runId.description: Unique identifier for this workflow run instance

stepId.description: Identifier of the workflow step this task corresponds to

agentId.description: Identifier of the agent to execute this task

input.description: Input data passed to the agent

metadata.description: Optional additional context for the task execution
